# 2 Baruch Chapter 39 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**39:1** Hear-therefore the-interpretation-of-the-cedar-tree.

**39:2** The-great-forest which-you-saw — that-is the-word-[matter] of-the-four-kingdoms which-will-rule-over-your-people; and-their-rule will-be-troubled and-distressed.

**39:3** And-as-for-what-you-saw — the-cedar which-was-left from-the-forest, and-the-vine coming and-subduing-it and-making-nothing-of-it with-the-water —

**39:4** This-is-the-word: the-last-[ruler] who-will-be-left from-that-forest-of-wickedness, and-he-will-be-[one] who-commanded-over-all-of-them — he-will-be-bound and-taken-up to-mount-Zion.

**39:5** And-my-Anointed-One will-convict-him-of-all-his-wickedness, and-will-assemble-against-him all-his-hosts.

**39:6** And-afterward my-Anointed-One will-kill-him, and-will-protect-the-rest-of-my-people who-will-be-found in-the-place-which-I-have-chosen.

**39:7** And-his-principate will-stand-fast-for-ever, until-the-world-of-corruption-is-ended and-until-the-times-aforesaid are-fulfilled.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. The interpretation of the vision: the four kingdoms (cedar forest) end with the last ruler brought to Zion for judgment by the Anointed One. The phrase "my Anointed One" is the clearest messianic title in 2 Baruch. The Messiah's role is to convict, kill the final enemy, and protect the remnant.*
